scripts.test:setup: npm --prefix tests ci && npm --prefix tests run setup
scripts.test: rm -rf dist .astro && astro build && (npm --prefix tests run static; s=$?; npm --prefix tests run browser; b=$?; exit $((s || b)))
scripts.test:quick: rm -rf dist .astro && astro build && (npm --prefix tests run static; s=$?; npm --prefix tests run browser:chromium; b=$?; exit $((s || b)))
scripts.test:live: npm --prefix tests run static; s=$?; npm --prefix tests run live; l=$?; exit $((s || l))
